own_body.title: Issues
own_body.summary: The section defines issues as user-reported problems and describes the interface for viewing, filtering by date, searching by ID, and exporting them. It details the display of issue descriptions, images, and comments, along with color-coded status indicators for resolved, waiting, and in-progress states. It also lists actions available for reporting new issues, editing, commenting, and removing existing ones.
